note: Golden cases for the bounded tool-calling agent's system prompt (`nettools agent`, opt-in behind NETTOOLS_ENABLE_AGENT since B-488). Lived as a string literal in `agent_loop.py` until 2026-08-21. Text byte-for-byte unchanged by the move.
refusal_marker: If you cannot fully answer within your remaining tool calls, say what you found and what you were not able to check.
refusal_note: This prompt names three distinct refusals where the other two name one, because an agent can fail in ways a single-shot analysis cannot: a refused tool call, a budget it ran out of, and an untraceable claim. The budget one is declared the marker here -- it is the refusal unique to this prompt's shape, and the one whose absence would let the agent quietly present a partial answer as a complete one.

cases.name: answerable_within_budget
cases.source: a question resolvable from two tool calls against committed fixtures
structural_properties: evidence is gathered before answering rather than guessed
every claim traces to a tool result actually received

cases.name: budget_exhausted_before_completion
cases.source: a question requiring more tool calls than the configured --max-iterations allows
structural_properties: the answer states what was found AND what was not checked
the shortfall is disclosed rather than the partial answer being presented as complete
